subject: Pilot boost package & combined credit/discount request
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura@valence.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Valence Procurement <procurement@valence.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Jul 2028 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot boost ask — credits + discount for quick conversion

Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the traceability features. We talked internally and would like to accelerate the pilot to production if we can get a slightly larger onboarding package.

Specifically, would Redwood consider:
- $15k in free credits applied to our pilot (to cover peak evaluation usage)
- 25% off list for the first 6 months post-pilot (we're comfortable committing to a minimum monthly consumption once we convert)
- a 90-day trial extension to align with our security review and SSO rollout

If you can approve a combined credits + discount package we can sign the SOW and get procurement moving this week. I attached a draft SOW with target milestones.

Attachments: Valence_SOW_draft.pdf

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
Valence Systems
laura@valence.ai
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@valence.ai>
Cc: Valence Procurement <procurement@valence.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jul 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot boost ask — credits + discount for quick conversion

Laura — really appreciate the clear ask. We want to remove friction for you to move forward. Proposal from our side (pilot boost package):

- $10k free Redwood platform credits applied to the pilot (to be used within 90 days of activation)
- 20% discount off standard hosted API rates for the first 120 days after conversion
- 90-day trial extension to align with your rollout

This is our standard sales+growth offer, but the $15k credit + 25% discount combination you requested needs executive exception because it exceeds our typical credit cap for SLA-backed pilots. Marissa / Ben — looping you in to ask for approval to approve an expanded concession (credits + discount) to close this pilot this week. I attached our pricing model to show economics.

Attachment: pricing-model.xlsx

If approved, I'll send an updated SOW and DocuSign link (procurement-friendly terms) and ask Valence to sign to lock dates.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Account Executive — Redwood Inference
(h) 415-555-0192 | hannah@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: (internal)
Date: Thu, 4 Jul 2028 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot boost ask — credits + discount for quick conversion

On Tue, Jul 2, 2028 at 10:12 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com> wrote:
> Laura — really appreciate the clear ask. We want to remove friction for you to move forward. Proposal from our side (pilot boost package):
>
> - $10k free Redwood platform credits applied to the pilot (to be used within 90 days of activation)
> - 20% discount off standard hosted API rates for the first 120 days after conversion
> - 90-day trial extension to align with your rollout
>
Thanks for the context and the economics, Hannah. Approve an expanded exception with conditions:

- Approve $12,500 in platform credits (one-time, applies to pilot only)
- Approve 22% discount off hosted API rates for the first 120 days after conversion
- Approve 90-day trial extension

Conditions:
1) Valence signs the SOW within 5 business days of receiving the DocuSign link.
2) Include a 6-month minimum committed capacity clause at conversion (we can define thresholds in the SOW).
3) Credits expire 180 days after activation if pilot does not convert.

I added a short exec note for record (exec-approval-note.pdf). Hannah, please confirm final wording in SOW and get signature. Finance has been copied internally for tracking.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

Subject: Final: Valence pilot boost package — approval & next steps

Laura / Procurement team — great news: leadership approved an exception with the following terms. Please review and confirm so we can circulate the SOW for signature.

Approved concession (one-time, pilot-focused):
- $12,500 in Redwood platform credits applied to the pilot (applies to usage within 180 days of activation)
- 22% off standard hosted API rates for the first 120 days post-conversion
- 90-day trial extension

Conditions (per exec approval):
- Valence signs the attached SOW within 5 business days of receiving DocuSign
- A 6-month minimum committed capacity clause will be included at conversion

Next steps:
1) I will upload the redlined SOW and send a DocuSign link by end of day.
2) After signature we'll issue the credits and apply the promotional pricing to your account; finance will provision tracking for the deal id VL-2028-311.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-valence
Attachment: Valence_SOW_draft.pdf (I'll send the final redline)

Laura — if this looks good I'll send the DocuSign now so procurement can route it internally.
